statements.t: “Acadia delivered strong results in the third quarter, and our positive momentum is driving our increased full-year guidance.

"We've expanded our footprint by opening 16 new acute facilities over the last four years, and based on the progress we've made so far this year, we now expect to deliver approximately $60 million of incremental EBITDA from these facilities in 2027 relative to 2026.

Third quarter 2026 Adjusted EBITDA includes a favorable pre-tax benefit related to an accrual for expected payments from the Florida supplemental payment program year ended September 30, 2026, which was $13.4 million compared to $5.6 million included in the Company's previous guidance.
The Company’s guidance does not include the impact of any future acquisitions, divestitures, transaction, legal and other costs or non-recurring legal settlements expense.
Our presentation of these non-GAAP financial measures should not be construed as an inference that our future results will be unaffected by unusual or nonrecurring items.

The Company is not able to provide a reconciliation of projected Adjusted EBITDA and adjusted earnings per diluted share, where provided, to expected results due to the unknown effect, timing and potential significance of transaction-related expenses and the tax effect of such expenses.
